'''Jason Foss Hunt Down 2 0''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Jason Foss]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-11488">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11488 Hunt Down 2 0], DeckTech (Jason "jade" Foss, 1 November 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11488/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11488/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018101018/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11488/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Hunt Down 2 0'''
* '''Author:''' Jason "jade" Foss
* '''Published:''' November 1, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 3.5
* '''Description:''' Standerd hunt down deck has done very well for me the last couple of months.

=== Strategy ===

This is a standerd hunt down deck so i wont go into to much detail on how to play it cause most people know how to play a huntdown deck.

Basicaly just pull the docking Bays out and rendili to get force activation going get vader to a docking bay and let visage do its thing if they deploy jedi on you than dual there @#$% and make them lose some force.And how much of a beatdown can they muster up if i have taken obi and luke out of the game

Cards I would like to put in but cant find room or dont have it.

Palpatine Another Mara SEarch And Destroy Crush The Rebelion Evader Imperial Decree

==== Matchups ====

==== Hidden Base ====

Wait till they flip deploy security precations.Probe there base make them lose force.dont get beatdown in space.It could be close pending skill of opponet but you should win.

New Objective Do your normal stuff hold a barrier in you hand so if they come to you you wont get beaten that much.

==== Profit ====

Go to tatooine and beat them up. This should be a easy game if you can duel ben out of the game and cross luke to the light side.just be carful about the new lando.

TIGIH Pick luke up fast and dont lose battles let visage do its thing.just drain at heavily fortified sites so he cant win battles you should win this one big time.
